messages:
alex_w: Heads-up — we're seeing a cluster of 413s on /v1/embeddings from mobile. Router trace shows large JSON arrays (many tiny strings) and some clients packing ~1.8MB payloads.
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-route: 413 spike (rate: 18/min) — top source: mobile-sdk-v2.
mira_s: Ugh. Are these 413s coming from the gateway or the runtime? Need attribution before we change routing.
alex_w: Router logs show `413` at the ingress layer with message \"request too large\". Runtime traces show very few events for same requests — suggests reject before routing.
sam: Quick question: do we count quota by 'embedding units' (vector count * dims) or by payload bytes? This affects how aggressive we should be in rejecting.
rachel: Our billing is embedding-units, but current quota checks are token/dimension-based only. The gateway only knows bytes. That's why big-but-low-dim payloads slip through.
joni: Proposal: introduce size-buckets at the router and route to three backends: fast-path (<=256KB), normal (256KB-1MB), and oversized (>1MB) which gets a controlled-accept queue or explicit fast-fail.
mira_s: +1 on buckets. Also recommend adding a per-tenant soft cap: once bytes/min > X, throttle to normal route to protect latency SLO.
alex_w: Example request pattern causing this:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rdw-embed-4k",
  "inputs": ["short text 1", ... repeated 1500x],
}
```
Clients batch many short strings into one huge payload.
sam: We should also change SDK to encourage chunking: SDKs should try to keep serialized request < 600KB by default and auto-split. Fallback to fast-fail if client explicitly sets `allow_oversize: false`.
rachel: Dashboard asks: we need visibility — percentile of request size, rate of 413s by tenant, and attribution in traces (router vs runtime). Proposed Grafana queries: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_request_size_bytes_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` and `sum(rate(embed_413_total[5m])) by (tenant, cause)`.
joni: UX/rollout thought: add a Console toggle (Size-aware routing) with canary: enable for 5% tenants, monitor 413, p50/p95 latencies, and cost delta. Flag path: `console.flags.size_route_v1`.
mira_s: One subtlety: some tenants legitimately need huge batches (vector search indexing). For them we should offer a 'bulk-ingest' route that bypasses strict latency SLAs but accepts bigger payloads. Mark it in console as "Bulk Ingest (best-effort)".
sam: Implementation sketch for SDK fast-fail:
```js
const MAX_BYTES = 600 * 1024;
if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(reqBody)) > MAX_BYTES) {
  if (!options.allowOversize) throw new Error('PayloadTooLarge');
  // else split into multiple requests
}
```
alex_w: Telemetry ask: add a tag `ingress_throttle_reason` with values [bytes_limit, dims_limit, rate_limit, none] to every embedding request metric so dashboards can filter quickly.
rachel: I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: `if rate(embed_413_total[5m]) > 5/min and p95(req_size) > 1MB -> ticket #ops` with a runbook link.
joni: Rollout plan summary: 1) router size-buckets + soft-cap (opt-out) 2) console flag + 5% canary 3) SDK auto-split/default MAX_BYTES 4) Dashboard + alerts + bulk-ingest route. Owner: @mira_s.
sam: I'll take SDK PR and add tests for split logic.
mira_s: I'll own router and console flag. I'll open RFC and add telemetry fields. PTAL: @alex_w @rachel.
alex_w: LGTM. Quick note — ensure the router returns structured 413 with `x-embed-reason: bytes` header so clients can surface correct error UX.
rachel: Added to runbook. I'll ship a dashboard prototype tonight. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/size-route (canary=5%) -> staging at 1719504400
alex_w: Thanks everyone — let's sync tomorrow if 5% canary shows regressions.
